messages:
Alice Tan: Heads-up — vendors are asking for a minimal sandbox so LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters can be validated by next Friday. Can we commit to a lightweight onramp plan?
Raj Patel: I can take the smoke test harness. Need the adapter contract and a small sample dataset. Is the gateway going to proxy auth or will partners handle tokens?
Alice Tan: Partners prefer us to proxy in sandbox (short-lived tokens) to simplify their infra. Security ok with short-lived test creds? @Mei FYI for SDK surface area.
Mei Chen: Short-lived creds are fine. SDK changes look small — we need two new config flags: `adapter_url` + `sandbox_mode=true`. Quick patch, e.g.:
```
# example config
redwood_sdk.configure(adapter_url="https://sandbox-gateway.example", sandbox_mode=True)
```
But we also need a compatibility shim for older LangChain adapters (v0.4 clients).
Carlos Ruiz: From partner side — we can bundle a sample index and a small QA prompt set. We prefer the sandbox to support streaming and function call stubs so our QA scripts mirror prod.
Raj Patel: Streaming + function-call stubs adds complexity but doable for a limited session window. Estimate: 2 engineer-days to wire the harness + 1 day for shim and tests.
Alice Tan: That timeline works if we start tomorrow. I'll own vendor coordination and asset drops. Carlos — can you provide the sample index (<=50 docs) and the prompt set by EOD tomorrow?
Carlos Ruiz: Yes, we'll drop a tar with index.json + prompts.txt by EOD PST. Also adding a small README on expected outputs.
Mei Chen: One more ask — please include a minimal failing example so we can validate regression alerts in Redwood Optimize. e.g., a prompt that currently triggers hallucination in their model variant.
Alice Tan: Good call. Adding to the checklist.
integrations-bot: Deploy job queued: `sandbox/onramp/harness` (id: sbx-9123). ETA 30m.
Raj Patel: I'll watch the deploy and run the harness once the job finishes. If anything fails, I'll push a hotfix branch `isv/onramp-smoke` and tag @Alice.
Alice Tan: Thanks team — let's aim for a short internal demo on Friday 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite and include partner contacts. :calendar: :rocket:
Carlos Ruiz: Appreciate it. We'll be ready for the demo and have folks on standby for Q&A.
Mei Chen: Noted. I'll include the compatibility shim in the PR and add unit tests for the two config flags.
Alice Tan: Perfect. Closing loop: deliverables checklist in the thread — Carlos asset drop, Raj harness run, Mei PR + tests, integrations-bot deploy success. If all green, partner sandbox demo Friday.
Carlos Ruiz: :thumbsup:
